notes: P0-5a data reading and validation (plan 4.5 S1-S4, S9, S10). Universal corrections follow decisions A3/Q9 (P6-24) and A5 (P6-02, P6-03, P6-04); P6-01 and the validation/unit contracts are pure software fixes (plan 4.5 dual-track).

The registry-backed repairs (P6-02/P6-03/P6-04) act only on objects whose sha256 is verified against gridform_core/data/validation/known_data_objects_v1.json; the shipped VALUE 101 packs carry constant, identical boundary series and no registry object, so their trajectories are unchanged.

advisory.title: Interconnector series read as period numbers
advisory.summary: Before P0-5a a declared csv_column was ignored: R029 interconnector prices and flows were read as the period index (0..17519), so imports, prices, costs and emissions of this Run are invalid.

corrections.description: A binding's declared csv_column (and csv_header) is read in every reading mode; an implicitly selected integer index column is refused (GF_DATA_INDEX_COLUMN).

advisory.title: Belgium price read as half-hourly GBP
advisory.summary: Before P0-5a the GBP1 Belgium price (hourly EUR/MWh) was read as half-hourly GBP/MWh by the canonical adapter and as zero by the retained kernel.

corrections.description: The verified GBP1 Belgium_price.csv is read from its EUR column, divided by the documented 1.1 EUR/GBP (R029 approved_r03 basis) and expanded hour -> two half-hours, in both profiles (decision A5).

advisory.title: Belgium and Netherlands flows swapped
advisory.summary: Before P0-5a the GBP1 Belgium role carried the BritNed (Netherlands) flow and vice versa, and the retained kernel fed three Connection objects with another country's files.

corrections.description: Interconnector flow files are assigned by NESO line identity (BRITNED_FLOW -> netherlands, NEMO_FLOW -> belgium ...), and every kernel Connection receives its own country's series, in both profiles (decision A5; the kernel wiring is part of P6-03).

advisory.title: Demand off the UTC clock after 2022-10-30
advisory.summary: Before P0-5a GBP1 demand and forecast were read in source row order; from 2022-10-30 they ran 2 periods off the UTC clock.

corrections.description: The verified GBP1 demand files are put on the UTC clock with the R029 audit rule (2022-10-30 duplicates dropped, four named gaps interpolated), in both profiles (decision A5). The doctoral forecast keeps its frozen one-period lead (P6-05 is corrected only).

advisory.title: Interconnector series stretched twice in the retained kernel
advisory.summary: Before P0-5a the retained kernel served each interconnector row for two periods (IterLimit_new), so a full year used only January to early July boundary data.

corrections.description: The retained kernel receives the interconnector series from the shared reader and assigns them period by period on the run clock (src[p]), in both profiles.

Data-pack validation has structural (decides valid), chronology and plausibility layers and a per-profile eligibility; market slots carry units; CSV mapping declares column, header, interval and EUR conversion.

deviation_signature.doctoral: legacy-v1 reader: an undeclared header is assumed (the first value of a headerless file is lost)

corrections.description: declared-v2 reading: an undeclared header is inferred (only a wholly non-numeric first row), several numeric columns are ambiguous (strict raises GF_DATA_AMBIGUOUS_COLUMN).

deviation_signature.doctoral: legacy clock: a half-hour profile longer than the window is expanded as hourly

corrections.description: The clock takes the resolution from interval_minutes (or an hourly length 8760/8784) before truncating, removes 29 February from a leap year and wraps a short series only when cyclic.

deviation_signature.doctoral: chronology and plausibility findings are warnings; registry-identified defects are repaired and recorded

corrections.description: Registry-identified data defects and chronology findings of non-workspace packs, and plausibility failures of scientific reference packs, make a pack ineligible for the profile (preflight error).
